title: Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin Rep. Ron Reynolds filed House Bill 815 on Monday, allowing each Texas city or county to put up to $10 million of public money into bitcoin starting Sept. 1, 2027. This post Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
